summary: yt-dlp Web UI provides a graphical browser interface to interact with the popular command-line media extraction tool. It allows you to manage and trigger downloads through a web browser instead of relying on terminal commands.
goodFor: Self-hosters who prefer a visual dashboard over command-line utilities for downloading video and audio content from supported sites.
watchOut: The development pace is slowing down, meaning fixes for upstream media site changes might lag behind the core extraction tool.
deployNotes: As a containerised application built with Go and Node.js, it typically runs well via Docker with persistent volume mounts required to save downloaded media files to your host storage.
